Found it and fixed it. The build breaks in the bundle stage, past the lint output — `resolveRelease` in `packages/shared/config.js` used a shallow `Object.assign` to merge package overrides onto the defaults, so overriding one key like `output.format` wiped out the sibling keys (`output.dir`, `output.entry`) instead of leaving them alone.

I changed the merge to combine `output` and `sourcemap` key-by-key instead of replacing the whole object, so overrides stay partial the way the comments describe. `build.js` now finishes clean with 5 warnings, 0 errors, and `verify.js` passes.
